name: caturday-chrome-extension
description: Chrome extension for showing cats on demand

scripts.release: npm run lint && npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.deploy: echo npx chrome-webstore-upload-cli upload --auto-publish --source package/caturday-`node -e "console.log(require('./package.json').version);"`.zip --extension-id mcciciniemdaoljfnhgfahdhhkhefcfp --client-id=$CLIENT_ID --client-secret=$CLIENT_SECRET --refresh-token=$REFRESH_TOKEN
